description: notify.delivery.list refused with the delivery-query family: the channel id names no row. An empty list for a typo would read as "this channel delivered nothing" — the exact lie the delivery log exists to make impossible — so the refusal says the QUERY was the unknown thing, and an archived channel's log stays readable behind includeArchived.

data.means: an empty list for a typo'd channel would read as 'this channel delivered nothing' — a lie the delivery log exists to make impossible; the refusal says the query itself was the unknown thing
